# **How Solar PV Works?**

Photovoltaic cells are found in solar panels, which are used in solar PV systems. These cells’ ability to convert sunlight into energy is provided by semiconducting components, most frequently silicon. Direct current (DC) power is generated when light from the sun strikes the solar panels, which causes the photovoltaic cells to release electrons.

An inverter is used to convert the generated electricity into a form that is suitable with electrical devices and home appliances. Alternating current (AC) is produced by the inverter from the direct current (DC) electricity generated by the solar panels. The most widely used type of energy in home settings is AC electricity. Utilising the converted electricity allows you to run your home’s electrical appliances and lighting while reducing your reliance on the traditional power grid.

Benefits of Installing  Solar PV in Home

## Reduce Electricity Bills

Possibly saving a lot of money on your electricity costs is one benefit of installing a rooftop solar PV system. You can significantly reduce or completely eliminate your dependency on the grid by producing your own electricity, which will lower your monthly expenses.

![Asset 2](https://pensolar.com.my/wp-content/uploads/2023/04/Asset-2.png)

## Reduced Environmental Impact

Solar photovoltaic (PV) systems produce clean energy without releasing toxic gases or adding to air pollution. This lessening of the impact on the environment encourages the use of a cleaner and more sustainable energy source. You can actively help protect the environment, lower your carbon footprint, and reduce greenhouse gas emissions by using solar energy.

![Asset 1](https://pensolar.com.my/wp-content/uploads/2023/04/Asset-1.png)

## Energy Independence

You may reduce your reliance on conventional energy sources and the volatile price of electricity by installing solar PV. You can better control your energy use and gain more independence by producing your own electricity, which lessens your vulnerability to changes in utility rates.

![offer icon5](https://pensolar.com.my/wp-content/uploads/2022/06/offer-icon5.png)

## Increased Value of Homes

Rooftop Solar PV System investments can raise the value of your home. Sustainable features and energy-efficient homes are becoming more and more popular among homeowners.

## **Process of Solar PV Installation**

- **Site Analysis and Design** **–** Our team of professionals will perform a complete assessment to ascertain your property’s solar potential. We consider factors including roof orientation, shading, and available space to create a unique solar PV system that maximises energy output.
- **Paperwork and Permits** **–** We take care of the documentation and licences needed for the installation process. Our team of professionals makes sure that all statutory and regulatory standards are satisfied, giving you a hassle-free experience.
- **Selection and Installation of Equipment** **–** We provide high-quality solar panels, inverters, and mounting methods. In order to ensure that the system is seamlessly incorporated into the existing electrical infrastructure of your home, our team of experts handle the installation with accuracy and care.
- **Net Metering and Grid Connectivity** **–** We take care of the grid connection process when the installation is finished. This makes it possible for you to benefit from net metering, a billing scheme that gives credit for any extra electricity your system produces and sends back into the grid. These credits are used to reduce your future electricity usage.

## Understanding of Energy Consumption

We consider the energy requirements and consumption patterns of your household to provide the best system size recommendation. We make sure that the solar PV system satisfies your present and future energy needs by analysing your electricity consumption.

![Pensolar2](https://pensolar.com.my/wp-content/uploads/2023/04/Pensolar2.png)

## Measure the System

We estimate the proper capacity of the solar system based on our assessment and your energy goals. We adjust the system size based on whether you want to offset all of your electricity use or only a portion of it.

![Pensolar3](https://pensolar.com.my/wp-content/uploads/2023/04/Pensolar3.png)

## Evaluation of Performance and Efficiency

Our team chooses solar panels and inverters with excellent efficiency ratings to boost your system’s energy output. Our top priorities are reliability and quality, so you can count on your solar system to keep performing at its best for many years.

Frequently Asked Questions

**How Does Solar Photovoltaic (PV) Modules Work?** PV Modules absorb the sun’s light and converts it directly to usable electricity with the help of inverters. It’s that simple!

**What Happens To Unused Electricity Generated By Solar Panels?** Homeowners may apply for Net Energy Metering (NEM). With NEM, any unused excess will be credited by TNB for later use (up to 12 months)

**What’s The Payback Period?** The duration of payback period ranges from 5-8 years depending on monthly electricity consumption & tariff rates

**How Much Does The System Costs?** Residential systems start at RM3500 – RM4000 /kWp. Please contact us for a free quote today
